principle_violations.reason: Both AreaCalculator and VolumeCalculator classes have multiple responsibilities: calculating areas and managing the list of shapes. VolumeCalculator also violates the SRP by not being responsible for volume calculations, since it is trying to reuse the area calculation logic.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate VolumeCalculator class that accepts solid shapes and defines a volume calculation method. Ensure AreaCalculator only handles area calculations.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class takes a list of shapes directly, which ties it to a concrete implementation. This becomes problematic when trying to extend functionality with new types of calculations or shapes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an abstraction, such as an interface or a base class, to represent the shapes. Inject dependencies through constructor parameters to follow the Dependency Inversion Principle.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
